title: Sequencer ops prep (Caden) - scratchpad
content:
Goal: concise 30-minute weekly with clear action handoffs. Use this as my prep notes; trim for the meeting doc before sending.

Structure (30 min):
- 5m: quick metrics + anomalies
- 10m: rollouts & capacity (decisions only)
- 8m: console/UX blockers + CI flakes
- 5m: open risks + quick wins / action review

Quick metrics (bring numbers):
- p50/p95 generation latency (hosted + dedicated) — grab last 24h from metrics dashboard (target p95 <= 220ms for short-seq).
- KV cache hit rate — is the prefix cache regression back up? (saw dip Wed evening)
- Dedicated capacity util — node pools A/B at 78% / 64% — confirm projected spike for partner test.

Incidents / anomalies to flag:
- RTT jitter around 2026-03-10 18:10 UTC: correlated with a host kernel update on nodepool-A (INF-3245). Status: mitigation done, root-cause investigation in progress. Ask SRE: is rollback safe?
- Two console deploys caused service-timeout errors in canary (PR #521) — retain fallback policy for this week.

Rollouts & capacity decisions (decision points):
- Canary -> 50% for seq-optimizations model-quant-v2? Current telemetry shows slight cost regression; need sign-off for latency vs cost tradeoff. Owner: Aisha. Decision requested in meeting.
- Reserved capacity bump request for ACME partner test next Tues (expected sustained QPS +35%). Proposal: add 2x small gpus for 48 hours with autoscale enabled. Owner: Jasper.

Console / developer UX blockers:
- Function-calling tracing missing top-level request id for multi-tool flows. UX: QA can't reproduce structured logs. Action: Lin to add request-id header propagation in gateway (INF-3301).
- Dashboard token-breakdown chart mislabels 'inference' vs 'aux' cost buckets — likely back-end mapping change. Quick fix: add migration script; longer-term: add schema validation at ingestion.

CI / infra notes:
- Flaky test suite: nightly-e2e failing 2/5 runs on sequence-length stress test. Hypothesis: batcher timeout too aggressive under small-host contention. Tentative runbook: increase batch timeout by 20ms and re-run. Owner: me (Caden) to patch and observe.

Open risks / discussion topics:
- If we enable global fallback routing to cheaper-region models, what SLA language do we need? Risk: subtle hallucination behavior change for enterprise customers. Need product guidance.
- Private deployment onboarding: on-prem checklist lacks KMS key rotation steps. Liaise with security.

Action items (short, for meeting summary):
- AI-1: Aisha Rao — Recommend canary % for model-quant-v2 with latest metrics and sign-off or veto by EOD Thu (2026-03-12).
- AI-2: Jasper Nguyen — Approve or amend reserved capacity plan for ACME partner test; escalate cost if needed. Due: 2026-03-13 morning.
- AI-3: Lin Park — Implement request-id header propagation in gateway and add unit test. PR by 2026-03-15.
- AI-4: Caden Murray — Patch batcher timeout in staging, run 5 consecutive e2e runs, report results. Target: 2026-03-13 end of day.
- AI-5: SRE (assign in meeting) — Confirm safety of rollback for kernel update across nodepool-A; if rollback unsafe, propose mitigations.

Notes to self / meeting prompts:
- Keep decisions timeboxed — if unresolved, move to async with owners.
- Ask product: appetite for visible behavior changes when routing fallback occurs (need short checklist).
- Remind team about docs: add a short section to the runbook showing how to toggle canary -> default fallback.

Scratch reminders (post-meeting):
- Clean up metrics chart screenshots and attach to meeting notes.
- Post meeting: update INF-3245 with status + next steps, tag SRE lead.
- If canary paused, trigger incident postmortem template for any customer-facing regressions.

Unresolved questions (for async follow-up):
- What are the precise cost deltas (tokens/sec * model multiplier) for quant-v2 vs quant-v1 under long-sequence traffic? (need spreadsheet).
- Should we add an explicit ‘behavior-check’ gate before routing fallbacks for enterprise customers? (prod input required)

---
Personal checklist before meeting:
- [ ] pull latest p95 graphs (grafana link)
- [ ] verify INF-3245 notes are up to date
- [ ] drop 3 bullet TL;DR in Slack #eng-serving before meeting
- [ ] update the meeting doc with final decision rows and owners

End of scratchpad.
